```sql
select s.id, s.status, s.cost, s.delivered_date
from shipments s
where s.cost >= (select avg(s2.cost) from shipments s2 where s2.status = 'RETURNED')
order by status desc, id
limit 3
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

avg_cost = df_shipments.filter(F.col("status") == "RETURNED").agg(F.avg("cost")).first()[0]

result = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("cost") >= avg_cost)
    .select("id", "status", "cost", "delivered_date")
    .orderBy(F.col("status").desc(), "id")
    .limit(3)
)
```


```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```

```python
    df_products.alias("p")

)
```
